title: Kyosou
tagline: Decentralized platform to organize fair and free contests like hackathons
description:
Musicians register their songs to a smart contract set up by the contest organizer, and participants vote and throw in their votes for the songs.
After a predetermined period of time, prizes will be awarded to the top performers, and all musicians will be able to receive money from the smart contract.
(The ability for contest organizers to freely set up contests as smart contracts like Uniswap will be implemented later.)
how_its_made:
For the backend, a standard token built by Bunnz and a smart contract on Polygon (testnet) that manages the ratings and rewards for each piece of music.
For the front end, Next.jst and Ethers.jsn implement the following two categories of functions.
Contest participants (musicians): Registration of music
Audience: Voting and contribution
